title: Prune matmul row-result item-pair sort transient

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit the canonical TypedRelationBlock sparse operator surface for one deletion-oriented duplicate materialization inside an existing owner. Keep deterministic CSR ordering, semiring semantics, operation budgets, entry bounds and direct-constructor validation unchanged; do not add a backend, cache, alternate block type, ordering flag or second execution path.

audit.finding: Each output row already requires row_result as the bounded sparse accumulator. Before GPU-91 the canonical emission loop called sorted(row_result.items()), creating a transient list of key/value pair tuples even though values were already retained in row_result and only sorted column keys are needed to produce deterministic CSR order.
audit.boundedness: The accumulator remains row-local and the existing MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES check still executes before appending the row. GPU-91 does not claim a new asymptotic memory bound; it removes only the item-pair materialization from the required per-row ordering step.
audit.ordering_requirement: A deterministic sort is still required because row_result insertion order follows contraction encounter order through the middle axis and is not a contractual column-order guarantee. GPU-91 therefore retains one sorted-key transient instead of inventing an ordered accumulator or alternate constructor.
audit.gardener_conclusion: Delete the unnecessary pair materialization while retaining the existing accumulator, ordering boundary and direct TypedRelationBlock constructor path.

change.before: for column, value in sorted(row_result.items()): append column and value
change.after: for column in sorted(row_result): append column and row_result[column]

semantic_invariants.csr_order: Output columns remain strictly increasing inside each emitted row because the same integer column keys are sorted before append.
semantic_invariants.semiring: Boolean, natural, tropical and evidence-dag accumulation still occurs entirely in the unchanged row_result contraction loop; only final row emission reads the already-computed scalar by key.
semantic_invariants.operation_budget: The exact multiply/add operation counter and refusal point are unchanged and remain ahead of row emission.
semantic_invariants.entry_bound: The existing len(values) + len(row_result) > MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES refusal remains unchanged and executes before sorting/emitting the row.
semantic_invariants.axes_and_subject: Typed middle-axis compatibility, exact Fourfold subject identity and output signature/axes are unchanged.
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest/Fourfold remain authoritative; TypedRelationBlock remains a regenerable internal computational view.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, wire schema, benchmark schema, authority or promotion contract changes.

result.summary: matmul now sorts only the row accumulator keys and looks up values from the existing row_result mapping, deleting the redundant sorted item-pair list while preserving deterministic CSR emission and all contraction semantics.
